title: Service assembly
requirement: Fit compatible virtual CPU, cooler, DDR5 memory and optional NVMe; verify orientation and mounting.

title: Power diagnostics
requirement: Qualify ATX standby, CPU power and protected rails with solver-backed measurements.

title: POST and memory
requirement: Validate simulated CPU and DDR5 initialization; diagnose EZ Debug indicators.

title: Interface qualification
requirement: Exercise PCIe, M.2, SATA, HDMI/VGA, USB and LAN using bounded device abstractions.

title: Component repair
requirement: Resolve three independent hardware faults; require measurement evidence and approved repair targets.

title: Thermal and reboot
requirement: Validate heatsink, cooling and protected restart from a fresh state.
